npc.vetrov_gordey.name: Gordey Vasilyevich Vetrov
line.vetrov_gordey.first.1: Vetrov. Keeper. If you've business, say it. If not, look at the sea. It hasn't any either.
line.vetrov_gordey.first.3: Looking's allowed. Touching: the railings only.
line.vetrov_gordey.lens.1: The lens was made in Paris in nineteen-oh-eight. The glass is over a hundred years old, and the dust on it is new every morning.
line.vetrov_gordey.log.1: The log hangs by the weather screen, in the tin box. You may read it, not write in it. There's one handwriting on this coast: mine.
line.vetrov_gordey.flash.1: Our light is white, one flash every ten seconds. A navigator knows from that alone it's Lyudmilovsk ahead.
line.vetrov_gordey.fog.1: In fog I switch on the horn. Two blasts every half minute. The gulls take offence. The ships don't.
line.vetrov_gordey.tower.1: Visitors go up by day, eight in the morning to nine at night. At night there are two of us up there: me and the light.
line.vetrov_gordey.town.1: I go to town on Saturdays. For paraffin and the paper. The wind brings me the rest.
line.vetrov_gordey.weather.1: The barometer doesn't lie; forecasts do. If the needle falls in the morning, put the kettle on by evening and keep the window shut.
line.vetrov_gordey.current.1: See that strip on the water, paler than the rest? A current. Forty years it's been there, and the pilot books still don't say so.
line.vetrov_gordey.clock.1: The clockwork runs on a weight, like a cuckoo clock, only the weight is forty kilos. Every four hours. That's all the exercise I need.
line.vetrov_gordey.navy.1: In the navy I was a signalman. All my life I flashed a lamp at someone. Now I flash at everyone at once.
line.vetrov_gordey.ships.1: The last time a ship saw the light was the year before last. Never mind. A lighthouse doesn't burn for those who are there. It burns for whoever comes.
line.vetrov_gordey.sun_day.1: By day nobody needs a lighthouse. By day I'm an ordinary man with a rag.
line.vetrov_gordey.sun_low.1: Time to light up soon. The sun goes down, I go up. That's how we live: taking turns.
line.vetrov_gordey.sun_night.1: Hear it ticking? That's the lens going round. While it ticks, the whole coast can sleep. Except me.
line.vetrov_gordey.sun_cloudy.1: Cloudy. They'll see the light earlier than usual today. I feel easier that way.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_ask.1: Hold on. You go into town? Good. My paraffin's down to the bottom of the can, and my leg's not been my own for a fortnight.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_ask.3: It is. And if a storm takes the line down? The spare lamp burns paraffin, and it has to be full. That's the rule, not a whim.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_ask.4: A can of paraffin from the hardware shop and today's paper from a kiosk. I'll pay you back, don't worry.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_hint.1: Paraffin at the hardware shop, the paper at a kiosk. The lighthouse can wait. The weather can't.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_hint.2: If they're out at the hardware shop, ask the woman at the counter. She always keeps some for me. Say it's for the lighthouse.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_bring.1: You've brought it? Hand it over. A full can, and the paper still smells of ink. Good.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_bring.2: Here's the money. And another thing: come up whenever you like now. At night too. Only don't wake me if I'm asleep on watch.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_bring.4: They don't. That's why you mustn't wake me.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_part.1: Half of it, I see. Paraffin without the paper is work without news. Bring the other half.
line.vetrov_gordey.paraffin_done.1: The lamp's full, the paper's read. I wrote it in the log: 'A helper came.' No name, sorry; I ran out of room.
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.title: Paraffin for the lighthouse
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.desc: The keeper of the lighthouse on the headland beyond Mayak station can't walk to town, and his spare lamp is running out of paraffin.
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.ask.log: The keeper, Vetrov, asked me to buy him paraffin and today's paper: his leg hurts, and the spare lamp must be kept full.
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.fetch.log: Paraffin is sold at the hardware shop, the paper at a kiosk. Then back out to the headland.
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.get_paraffin.o: Buy a can of paraffin at the hardware shop
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.bring.log: I have it all. Now to take it to the keeper before dark.
quest.lighthouse_paraffin.done: Vetrov says I can go up the lighthouse any time. Even at night, when there's only him and the light up there.
item.paraffin.name: Can of paraffin
item.paraffin.desc: A one-litre tin can of paraffin, its cap on a little chain. The smell takes you straight back to the dacha.
ui.lh.up: E — climb up to the gallery
lh.tower.locked: Locked. Chalked on the door: 'Visitors 8 to 21. The Keeper.'
lh.log.head: Watch log of the Mayak lighthouse. Light: white flashing, period 10 s. Horn: 2 blasts, period 30 s.
lh.log.remark.gale.1: Gale. The lantern panes hum like strings. Wound the clockwork twice more than needed.
lh.log.remark.gale.2: The wind took the bucket off the porch. Found the bucket. The porch is still here.
lh.log.remark.gale.3: Waves breaking over the rocks at the point. The gulls sit on the ground: it'll last.
lh.log.remark.thunder.1: A thunderstorm went by over the sea to the south. Checked the lightning rod: sound.
lh.log.remark.thunder.2: Lightning into the water beyond the shoal. The power flickered; the lamp held.
lh.log.remark.fog.1: Thick fog off the sea. The horn worked; the gulls took offence.
lh.log.remark.fog.2: In the fog you can't see the light even from the porch. So they listen to the horn.
lh.log.remark.fog.3: Fog. Heard an engine off the point, answered with the horn. The engine went off along the coast.
lh.log.remark.ice.1: Ice along the shore. The sea is quiet; it only creaks.
lh.log.remark.ice.2: Ice out to the shoal. The light burns for whoever comes in spring.
lh.log.remark.frost.1: Frost. The lantern panes patterned inside; wiped them with spirit.
lh.log.remark.frost.2: Hard frost. Checked the paraffin in the spare lamp: not thickened.
lh.log.remark.calm.1: Calm and clear. You can see the light to the horizon, and nobody to see it.
lh.log.remark.calm.2: Still. You can hear the dogs barking in town.
lh.log.remark.calm.3: Stars. Counted three satellites and one shooter. Wishes are not to be entered in the log.
lh.log.remark.plain.3: Visitors came to look. Two went up, two came down.
lh.log.remark.plain.4: Painted the gallery railings. Drying tonight; may be touched in the morning.
